parameters.content:
## A. Chat Telegram
Pesan masuk → cek pemilik bot → **AI Agent** (Gemini) memilih tool → balas.
Chat pertama yang mengirim /start otomatis jadi pemilik.

parameters.query:
-- p1 = chat id Telegram pengirim. Chat pertama yang mengirim pesan otomatis
-- menjadi pemilik bot; chat lain ditolak.
with reg as (
  update settings set value = $1::text, updated_at = now()
  where key = 'telegram_chat_id' and coalesce(value, '') = ''
  returning value
)
select
  coalesce((select value from reg), (select value from settings where key = 'telegram_chat_id')) as owner_chat_id,
  (select value from reg) is not null as just_registered,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) from settings) as settings;

options.systemMessage:
=Kamu adalah Jarvis Akademik, asisten pribadi yang mengatur jadwal belajar seorang mahasiswa Universitas Kristen Petra lewat Telegram.

Waktu sekarang: {{ $now.setZone('Asia/Jakarta').setLocale('id').toFormat("cccc, d LLLL yyyy HH:mm") }} WIB (ISO: {{ $now.setZone('Asia/Jakarta').toISO({ suppressMilliseconds: true }) }}).
Semua waktu yang kamu kirim ke tool WAJIB ISO 8601 dengan offset +07:00, contoh 2026-10-24T23:59:00+07:00. Kata seperti "besok", "Jumat", "minggu depan" selalu dihitung dari waktu sekarang. Deadline tanpa jam = 23:59 hari itu.

PERANMU
- Kamu yang memutuskan prioritas dan apa yang dikorbankan. Kamu TIDAK menghitung jam sendiri: penempatan blok belajar di kalender selalu lewat tool susun_ulang_jadwal, yang menjamin tidak bentrok dengan kuliah dan acara lain.
- Kalender "Jarvis Akademik" hanya berisi blok buatanmu. Kalender utama user (kuliah, organisasi, kerja) hanya dibaca, tidak pernah diubah.

CARA KERJA
1. Tugas atau ujian baru:
   a. Panggil lihat_tugas dulu untuk cek apakah sudah ada (mis. sudah tersinkron dari Lentera/Classroom). Jika sudah ada, perbarui dengan ubah_tugas, jangan tambah baru.
   b. Jika belum ada, panggil tambah_tugas. Kalau user tidak menyebut lama pengerjaan, tebak wajar (kuis 30-60 menit, tugas biasa 2-3 jam, laporan/proyek 4-6 jam, persiapan ujian 6-10 jam) dan sebutkan tebakanmu supaya user bisa mengoreksi.
   c. Panggil susun_ulang_jadwal, lalu sebutkan kapan saja blok untuk tugas itu.
2. Balasan check-in (user menjawab pesan "Check-in malam"; nomor [#id] di pesan itu adalah task_id):
   - Selesai ("udah", "beres") -> catat_progres dengan finished=true.
   - Sebagian ("baru setengah", "1 jam doang") -> catat_progres dengan minutes_done perkiraan.
   - Belum ("belum", "capek", "ga sempet") -> catat_progres minutes_done=0, lalu susun_ulang_jadwal. Tanggapi dengan empati singkat, tanpa menggurui.
   - Jika tidak jelas tugas mana yang dimaksud, panggil lihat_jadwal untuk hari ini atau tanya balik.
3. User tidak bisa belajar (sakit, acara, pulang kampung, lomba):
   - Pastikan rentang waktunya. Jika ambigu (mis. "3 hari" tanpa tanggal mulai), tanya balik.
   - Ini perubahan besar: sampaikan rencanamu dalam 1-2 kalimat dan minta konfirmasi ("Lanjut?") sebelum mengubah apa pun, kecuali user sudah jelas menyuruh langsung.
   - Setelah setuju: tandai_tidak_tersedia, lalu susun_ulang_jadwal, lalu jelaskan perubahan utamanya.
   - Jika user ternyata bisa lagi lebih cepat: hapus_tidak_tersedia, lalu susun_ulang_jadwal.
4. Hasil susun_ulang_jadwal memuat "tidak_muat" (tugas yang waktunya tidak cukup) dan "lewat_deadline". Jika tidak_muat tidak kosong:
   - Katakan jujur, contoh: "Laporan Jarkom realistisnya cuma kekejar sekitar 70%."
   - Usulkan prioritas: tugas berbobot tinggi (bobot 3) dan deadline terdekat didahulukan. Untuk tugas berbobot rendah usulkan menurunkan target (mis. target_pct 60, fokus ke bagian yang nilainya besar) atau menandainya dropped.
   - Ubah target_pct atau status hanya setelah user setuju, lalu susun_ulang_jadwal lagi.
   - Jika ada lewat_deadline, tanya apakah sudah dikumpulkan; jika ya, ubah_tugas status=done.
5. Pertanyaan "hari ini/besok/minggu ini ada apa?" -> lihat_jadwal untuk rentang itu.
6. Preferensi waktu ("jangan jadwalin di atas jam 9 malam", "hari Minggu libur", "maksimal 3 jam sehari") -> ubah_pengaturan, lalu susun_ulang_jadwal. Kode rest_days: 0=Minggu, 1=Senin, ..., 6=Sabtu.
7. Minta cek Lentera/Classroom atau "sync" -> sinkronkan_lentera_classroom, lalu ringkas tugas baru dan peringatan dari hasilnya.
8. Mata kuliah yang sudah selesai tapi masih muncul dari Classroom ("Basis Data udah selesai semester lalu"):
   ubah_pengaturan key=classroom_ignore value="+<nama kelas>" (awalan + berarti menambah ke daftar), lalu sinkronkan_lentera_classroom. Tugas lama dari kelas itu otomatis dibuang.
   Jika user menyebut tanggal mulai semester, simpan sebagai semester_start (YYYY-MM-DD): semua kelas yang dibuat sebelum tanggal itu diabaikan.

GAYA BALASAN
- Bahasa Indonesia santai seperti teman yang bisa diandalkan. Ringkas: maksimal sekitar 12 baris, pakai daftar pendek dengan tanda • bila perlu.
- Teks biasa saja: jangan pakai Markdown (*, **, _, #). Emoji boleh secukupnya.
- Tulis waktu dalam format lokal, mis. "Kam 23 Okt 19:00". Jangan tampilkan task_id atau ID lain kecuali user memintanya.
- Jangan mengarang data. Jika tool mengembalikan error, jelaskan apa adanya dalam bahasa sederhana dan sarankan langkah berikutnya.

parameters.content:
## B. Jarvis Tools (dipanggil agent & jadwal)
Semua aksi lewat satu pintu. Input divalidasi di Code node sebelum menyentuh database.

parameters.query:
-- Daftar tugas aktif + waktu tidak tersedia ke depan (untuk agent).
select
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(t order by t.deadline nulls last, t.weight desc), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select id, course, title, task_type, source,
            to_char(deadline at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'Dy DD Mon YYYY HH24:MI') as deadline_wib,
            deadline, effort_minutes, done_minutes, weight, target_pct,
            greatest(0, round(effort_minutes * target_pct / 100.0)::int - done_minutes) as remaining_minutes
     from tasks where status = 'open'
     order by deadline nulls last limit 60) t) as open_tasks,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(u order by u.start_at), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select id, reason,
            to_char(start_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as mulai,
            to_char(end_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as selesai,
            start_at
     from unavailability where end_at > now()) u) as unavailable;

-- p1 = task id, p2 = JSON perubahan (field yang tidak dikirim tidak diubah).
-- Dibungkus CTE + SELECT: jika id tidak ada, node mengembalikan 0 baris (bukan "success").
with upd as (
update tasks t set
  title          = coalesce(c.title, t.title),
  course         = coalesce(c.course, t.course),
  task_type      = coalesce(c.task_type, t.task_type),
  deadline       = coalesce(c.deadline, t.deadline),
  effort_minutes = coalesce(c.effort_minutes, t.effort_minutes),
  done_minutes   = coalesce(c.done_minutes, t.done_minutes),
  weight         = coalesce(c.weight, t.weight),
  target_pct     = coalesce(c.target_pct, t.target_pct),
  status         = coalesce(c.status, t.status),
  notes          = coalesce(c.notes, t.notes),
  updated_at     = now()
from jsonb_to_record($2::jsonb) as c(title text, course text, task_type text, deadline timestamptz,
                                       effort_minutes int, done_minutes int, weight int, target_pct int,
                                       status text, notes text)
where t.id = $1::bigint
returning t.id, t.course, t.title, t.task_type,
          to_char(t.deadline at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'Dy DD Mon YYYY HH24:MI') as deadline_wib,
          t.effort_minutes, t.done_minutes, t.weight, t.target_pct, t.status
)
select * from upd;

-- p1 = task id, p2 = menit dikerjakan, p3 = selesai (bool), p4 = catatan
with upd as (
  update tasks set
    done_minutes = done_minutes + greatest($2::int, 0),
    status = case when $3::boolean then 'done' else status end,
    updated_at = now()
  where id = $1::bigint
  returning id, title, effort_minutes, done_minutes, target_pct, status
), ins as (
  insert into checkins (task_id, minutes_done, finished, note)
  select id, greatest($2::int, 0), $3::boolean, nullif($4::text, '') from upd
  returning id
), blk as (
  update study_blocks set status = case when $3::boolean or $2::int > 0 then 'done' else 'missed' end
  where task_id = $1::bigint and status = 'planned' and start_at < now()
  returning id
)
select upd.*,
       greatest(0, round(upd.effort_minutes * upd.target_pct / 100.0)::int - upd.done_minutes) as remaining_minutes,
       (select count(*) from blk) as past_blocks_marked
from upd;

-- p1 = mulai, p2 = selesai (timestamptz), p3 = alasan
insert into unavailability (start_at, end_at, reason)
values ($1::timestamptz, $2::timestamptz, nullif($3::text, ''))
returning id, reason,
          to_char(start_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as mulai,
          to_char(end_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as selesai;

-- p1 = mulai, p2 = selesai: hapus semua periode tidak tersedia yang beririsan
with del as (
  delete from unavailability
  where start_at < $2::timestamptz and end_at > $1::timestamptz
  returning id
)
select count(*) as removed from del;

-- p1 = key, p2 = value, p3 = tambahkan (true) atau ganti (false).
-- Key sudah divalidasi di Code node.
insert into settings (key, value, updated_at) values ($1::text, $2::text, now())
on conflict (key) do update set
  value = case
    when $3::boolean and settings.value <> '' then settings.value || ', ' || excluded.value
    else excluded.value
  end,
  updated_at = now()
returning key, value;

-- p1 = dari, p2 = sampai (timestamptz): blok belajar Jarvis di rentang itu
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x.start_at), '[]'::jsonb) as blocks from (
  select b.id as block_id, b.task_id, t.title, t.course, b.start_at, b.end_at, b.status,
         to_char(b.start_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') || '-' ||
         to_char(b.end_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'HH24:MI') as waktu
  from study_blocks b join tasks t on t.id = b.task_id
  where b.start_at >= $1::timestamptz and b.start_at < $2::timestamptz
) x;
select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) as settings from settings;

parameters.query: select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) as settings from settings;

-- p1 = JSON array task dari Lentera/Classroom (lihat lib/normalize.js)
-- p2 = JSON array nama kelas Classroom yang dilewati (semester lalu / diabaikan)
with incoming as (
  select * from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as x(source text, source_id text, course text, title text,
         task_type text, deadline timestamptz, effort_minutes int, weight int, status text)
), up as (
  insert into tasks (source, source_id, course, title, task_type, deadline, effort_minutes, weight, status)
  select source, source_id, course, title, task_type, deadline, effort_minutes, weight, status from incoming
  on conflict (source, source_id) do update set
    title      = excluded.title,
    course     = excluded.course,
    deadline   = excluded.deadline,
    status     = case when excluded.status = 'done' then 'done' else tasks.status end,
    updated_at = now()
  where tasks.title    is distinct from excluded.title
     or tasks.course   is distinct from excluded.course
     or tasks.deadline is distinct from excluded.deadline
     or (excluded.status = 'done' and tasks.status <> 'done')
  returning (xmax = 0) as inserted, id, source, course, title, deadline, status
), dropped as (
  -- tugas yang belum selesai dari kelas yang sekarang dilewati
  update tasks set status = 'dropped', updated_at = now()
  where source = 'classroom' and status = 'open'
    and course in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce($2::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)))
    and id not in (select id from up)
  returning id
), expired as (
  -- kuis Lentera yang sudah tutup lebih dari 1 hari tidak bisa dikerjakan lagi
  update tasks set status = 'expired', updated_at = now()
  where source = 'lentera' and status = 'open' and deadline < now() - interval '1 day'
    and id not in (select id from up)
  returning id
)
select
  coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', up.id, 'course', up.course, 'title', up.title, 'source', up.source,
    'deadline_wib', to_char(up.deadline at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI')))
    filter (where up.inserted and up.status = 'open'), '[]'::jsonb) as new_tasks,
  count(*) filter (where not up.inserted) as updated_count,
  count(*) filter (where up.status = 'done' and not up.inserted) as marked_done_count,
  (select count(*) from expired) as expired_count,
  (select count(*) from dropped) as dropped_from_old_courses_count,
  (select count(*) from incoming) as incoming_count
from up;

-- Semua bahan untuk penjadwal dalam satu baris.
select
  (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) from settings) as settings,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(t), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select id, title, course, task_type, deadline, effort_minutes, done_minutes, weight, target_pct, status
     from tasks where status = 'open') t) as tasks,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(u), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select start_at as start, end_at as "end", coalesce(reason, 'tidak tersedia') as label
     from unavailability where end_at > now()) u) as unavailable;

parameters.content:
## C. Otomatis harian
06:30 sinkron Lentera + Classroom → susun ulang → kirim rencana pagi.
20:00 check-in malam. Pesan juga disimpan ke memori agent supaya balasan "udah"/"belum" dipahami.

parameters.query:
-- p1 = session id (chat id), p2 = isi pesan. Menyimpan pesan check-in sebagai
-- pesan "AI" di memori agent, agar balasan user ("udah", "belum") dipahami.
insert into n8n_chat_histories (session_id, message)
values ($1::text, jsonb_build_object(
  'type', 'ai',
  'data', jsonb_build_object(
    'content', $2::text, 'tool_calls', '[]'::jsonb, 'invalid_tool_calls', '[]'::jsonb,
    'additional_kwargs', '{}'::jsonb, 'response_metadata', '{}'::jsonb)))
returning id;

-- Bahan pesan check-in malam.
with day0 as (
  select (date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta') at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta') as d
)
select
  (select value from settings where key = 'telegram_chat_id') as chat_id,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x.start_at), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select b.id, b.task_id, t.title, t.course, b.start_at, b.end_at, b.status,
            to_char(b.start_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'HH24:MI') || '-' ||
            to_char(b.end_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'HH24:MI') as jam
     from study_blocks b join tasks t on t.id = b.task_id, day0
     where b.start_at >= day0.d and b.start_at < now() and t.status = 'open') x) as today_blocks,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x.start_at), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select b.task_id, t.title, t.course, b.start_at,
            to_char(b.start_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'HH24:MI') || '-' ||
            to_char(b.end_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'HH24:MI') as jam
     from study_blocks b join tasks t on t.id = b.task_id, day0
     where b.start_at >= day0.d + interval '1 day' and b.start_at < day0.d + interval '2 day') x) as tomorrow_blocks,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x.deadline), '[]'::jsonb) from (
     select id, title, course, deadline,
            to_char(deadline at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as deadline_wib
     from tasks where status = 'open' and deadline between now() and now() + interval '3 days') x) as due_soon;

-- p1 = session id (chat id), p2 = isi pesan. Menyimpan pesan check-in sebagai
-- pesan "AI" di memori agent, agar balasan user ("udah", "belum") dipahami.
insert into n8n_chat_histories (session_id, message)
values ($1::text, jsonb_build_object(
  'type', 'ai',
  'data', jsonb_build_object(
    'content', $2::text, 'tool_calls', '[]'::jsonb, 'invalid_tool_calls', '[]'::jsonb,
    'additional_kwargs', '{}'::jsonb, 'response_metadata', '{}'::jsonb)))
returning id;
